column1: # Vendor ssh-mcp 2.18.0 redactor cases (docs/migration/vendor-ssh-mcp-rules.md section 2.2 and 7.1). UTF-8, columns separated by one TAB:
# mode: entropy = the 2.x call (entropy scan on, threshold 4.5); plain = entropy scan off; threshold=4.4 = entropy scan with that threshold.
# input and expected: <LF> <CR> <TAB> <NBSP> one character, <U+1F600>-style any code point, <SAME> (expected only) = the input unchanged.
# Cases that need a generated input (VR-290, VR-291) and the entropy unit cases (VR-315, VR-316) are in the test classes. VR-318 (redactRecord) is not ported: 2.x does not use it.
